edits.headline: Projectile hits tanker off Oman and injures 11 Indian crew
edits.subheadline: India's foreign ministry condemned the attack on the Panama-flagged MT On Peace in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf News reported.
editorialBody: A projectile struck the Panama-flagged tanker MT On Peace in the Strait of Hormuz off Oman, injuring 12 crew members including 11 Indians, Gulf News reported. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the attack and called for an immediate end to attacks on shipping. The injured were being treated in Khasab, Oman, the report said.
The US Air Force withdrew all its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported.

Dozens of people were quarantined in Siberia after a worker at a plague laboratory died, the Associated Press reported. Russia denied imposing anti-plague measures after the death, Al Jazeera reported.
Televangelist Jim Bakker, who lost his PTL Club empire in sex and money scandals, has died at 86, the Associated Press reported.
The separatist Parti Québécois, which promises another independence referendum, won Quebec's provincial election but fell short of a majority, the Associated Press reported.
India's Union Cabinet passed a resolution marking Narendra Modi's 25 years as head of a government, All India Radio reported.
